ideas.idea: Give each mug its own page and URL (/mugs/<id>) with links, possibly Product structured data
ideas.why:
Catalogue renders mugs as plain

text with no links, so individual products can't be found or linked.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to index.html
ideas.why: Accurate since the viewport tag is missing, but it's a standard item with little effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Add prices, sizes, materials and shipping details as text on the pages
ideas.why: Home contains only one sentence of text and no product details, so adding them gives machines and visitors real content.

ideas.idea: Give each page its own title and description via a head manager
ideas.why: Both routes share the single 'Vite App' title, so per-route titles need a head manager in this SPA.

ideas.idea: Declare the site's domain and add an absolute canonical link
ideas.why: Valid but depends on an unknown domain and is standard advice for almost any site.
